# Asferia Adventure
> Licensed local tour operator in Ridder, East Kazakhstan (since 2023). Private and group journeys across East Kazakhstan and the Kazakh Altai: Katon-Karagay National Park, Mount Belukha views, Lake Yazevoye, Rakhmanov Springs, Lake Markakol, the Old Austrian Road, Kiin-Kerish, Western Altai near Ridder. One team arranges route, 4WD vehicles, English-speaking guides, accommodation, meals, airport transfers and border-zone permits. Summer: May–October. Winter: cat-skiing and snowmobile tours, December–March. Multi-day private journeys from USD 1,000 per person.

Contact: WhatsApp +7 777 065 02 60 · asferia@mail.ru · https://asferia.kz
